name: Juku
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood cram school (Himawari Gakushuujuku): a notice about class times changing, a first day working part-time as a teacher, a tuition-and-timetable guide, an online mock-exam application starting, a comparison of two summer special-class plans, a lesson learned about teaching with students' feelings in mind, teaching a new part-time tutor the basics, an essay on why summer intensive courses started, a mock-exam application guide, a column on how online applications changed the daily flow, new winter-course class-placement standards, a reflection on the meaning of experience built up at a cram school, and a one-year cooperation report with a local education-support council. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
